Wastewater from the preliminary treatment system gravity flows to one of two oxidation ditch units with integral clarifiers for secondary (biological) treatment.
Wastewater from the preliminary treatment system gravity flows to one of two oxidation ditch units with integral clarifiers for secondary (biological) treatment.
The effluent from the secondary treatment system flows to one of three evaporation/inflitration ponds for disposal.
Scum and sludge wasting from the integral clarifiers are pumped to one of the nine sludge-drying beds.
The scum, sludge, grit and screenings collected are transported to the Alan L. Horton Wastewater Treatment Plant located in Desert Hot Springs, for disposal with its sludge, grit and screenings.
A private contractor hauls away the combined solids to a land fill or a private composting facility.
